result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there are a few visual/content problems: a suspicious '−100%' discount badge, truncated text on a restaurant card, and an empty partially-visible filter chip.

issues.description: The pizza card in 'Popular right now' shows a '−100%' badge, implying the item is completely free. This is almost certainly a data or calculation error in the discount label.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount value from the backend; cap or validate discount percentages (e.g., show '€0 delivery' or a correct percentage) instead of rendering −100%.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol' is hard-clipped mid-word with no ellipsis, making the restaurant name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (…) or allow the title to wrap within the card bounds, and ensure the card layout doesn't clip text abruptly at the screen edge.

issues.description: A sixth category chip after 'Healthy' is partially visible as an empty pill with no readable label, which looks broken rather than like an intentional scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so at least part of the label text is visible, or add a gradient fade at the edge to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The last card ('−100%' pizza) is cut off at the bottom of the viewport with no visible restaurant name or details, so the discounted item cannot be identified without scrolling.
issues.suggestion: This may just be scroll position, but consider ensuring key info (name, rating) is anchored near the image top or verify the card renders completely when scrolled into view.
